about: Golden set for the memory evaluation (NH-65). Each scenario gives optional current facts and new messages; `expected` is what the memory should hold afterwards (category, and keywords that must all appear — 'a|b' means either), `must_not` lists keyword sets no fact may match. Run: supabase/eval/memory/run.ts.
